basics.name: Conor Hinchee
basics.summary: Software engineer with 6+ years building production systems across e-commerce, SaaS, and AI. Work spans React frontends, GraphQL APIs, event-driven pipelines, and TypeScript migrations. Most recently: designing and shipping Odin, a self-hosted multi-agent runtime with persistent memory, 50+ tools, and a nightly self-improvement loop — built on the Anthropic Messages API.

highlights: Tech Stack: React, TypeScript, Webpack, Jest, React Testing Library, Apollo Server, Apollo Client, GCP, GitHub Actions, Adobe Launch, CommerceTools API
Rebuilt the product carousel from the ground up — optimized component architecture cut render cycles and improved core web vitals scores site-wide.
Led integration of Google Retail Search, replacing keyword matching with ML-ranked results and improving search-to-conversion rates.
Enforced 100% unit test coverage across owned components using Jest and React Testing Library, catching regressions before they reached staging.
Maintained the Express open-source project — triaged issues, reviewed PRs, and coordinated releases with external contributors.
Mentored junior engineers through code review and pairing, with two direct reports moving into independent feature ownership.
Held on-call rotation responsibilities, leading incident response and postmortem documentation for production issues.
Tech Stack: React, Bootstrap, Stripe, Node.js, TypeScript, GCP, Firebase
Architected and delivered the initial product from zero — designed data models, built the frontend, and shipped the first paying customer integration.
Built, tested, and deployed GCP Cloud Functions handling payment webhooks, user lifecycle events, and async task processing.
Integrated Stripe for subscription billing including webhook handling, failed payment recovery, and plan upgrade flows.
Handled high-volume inbound support for internet and cable services, consistently achieving top-tier customer satisfaction scores.

projects.name: Odin — Self-Hosted Agent Runtime
projects.description: Multi-agent AI orchestrator built on the Anthropic Messages API. Features a seven-agent pipeline (Týr → Muninn → Heimdall → Huginn → Hermod → Norns), BullMQ async job processing, persistent memory via an Obsidian vault, 50+ specialized tools, and a nightly Kvasir self-improvement loop that analyzes traces, versions prompts, and gates its own changes. Takes a spec and opens a pull request. Runs research tasks that span hours without user intervention.
